contract: mosaic-contract.json: close-set photo wall, collection filters and fullscreen viewer. Homepage hero preserved.

accessibility.evidence: Native anchors remain usable without JavaScript. Text-only modal controls, initial Close focus, error announcement, Next recovery, and delayed focus restoration tested at 390px. All local image elements have alt text.

responsive.evidence: Mosaic rendered with five equal columns at 1440px and two at 390px; no horizontal overflow at either viewport.

loading.evidence: Viewer displays Loading photograph before full-resolution image loads; image dimensions reserve gallery space.

empty.reason: Static curated collection has no search/query or user-created dataset; no empty query state.

error.evidence: Replaced viewer source with invalid image data; actual error message offered original link or another image.

partial.evidence: After image error, Next loaded a different image successfully without closing viewer.

success.evidence: Home mosaic 19 photos and title tile; Our Work 49 photos and title tile. Aditi filter displayed 12 photographs; viewer caption reported 1 of 12 and opened successfully. All local gallery links resolve. All 203 images remain in complete story galleries.

permission.reason: Images imported from the supplied publicly accessible Drive folders. Public static galleries require no account or runtime Drive access. Two website backup archives excluded.

renderedEvidence.observation: Five-column square mosaic with narrow paper gutters and centred typography tile, mixed colour and monochrome.
Two-column mosaic with wrapping text filter controls and no horizontal overflow.
